title: Style and Industry Rotation Strategy: Relative Return
tldr: Multi-factor style and industry rotation strategies combining macro, fundamental, valuation, and technical factors achieve significant excess returns with information ratios up to 1.84.
abstract: The paper proposes quarterly and monthly style rotation strategies (growth-value, large-small cap, dividend-growth) and industry rotation strategies using macro, fundamental, valuation, and technical factors. The quarterly growth-value rotation model achieves 26.63% annualized return with 20.40% excess return (IR=1.18) over 2014-2026.02. The monthly large-small cap composite signal achieves 26.84% annualized return with 20.64% excess return (IR=1.84). The dividend-growth composite factor achieves 18.41% annualized return with 13.29% excess return (IR=1.38). The industry rotation ETF portfolio achieves 16.50% annualized return with 11.40% excess return (IR=1.01). Factors show strong complementary effects across different market environments.
strategy: The paper proposes multiple relative return rotation strategies: 1) Quarterly growth-value rotation: combines macro factors (PMI new orders, PPI-CPI, 1Y bond YTM, 3M US bond YTM) with price-volume factors (macro-adjusted momentum, PB change rate differential, market sentiment). Signals are equally weighted across dimensions. Value signal allocates to Dividend ETF; growth signal allocates to ChiNext ETF. [source: "将各维度信号值等权得到综合信号。综合信号指向价值时全仓配置红利ETF，反之全仓配置创业板ETF，若信号值为0则进行等权配置"] 2) Monthly growth-value rotation: uses macro (term spread, US bond yields, credit via loan growth, inflation via PPI-CPI), valuation (relative PB with rolling 3-year percentile thresholds), and fundamental (analyst expected ROE) dimensions. 3) Monthly large-small cap rotation: integrates macro, valuation, fundamental, capital flow (analyst expectations, large-order flow, foreign capital pressure, ETF shares, dragon-tiger list, margin buying), sentiment, and price-volume dimensions. 4) Dividend-growth rotation: seven factors including bond-equity comparison, US bond yields, credit, economy, industry prosperity, sentiment, and dividend momentum. 5) Industry rotation: four-quadrant framework combining prosperity, sentiment, technical, and macro factors. [source: "单因子多策略：根据每个维度因子得分单独推荐头部行业，取并集汇总；复合因子策略：对每个行业进行多维度因子的等权打分，根据综合得分，选取头部5行业等权构建"]
method: For quarterly strategies, each factor generates a binary signal based on predefined conditions: seasonal average difference, weighted month-on-month change, or comparison of recent versus historical averages. [source: "PMI新订单|季均差分>0|季均差分<0"] Factor signals within each dimension are equally weighted, then dimension signals are equally weighted to form the composite signal. For monthly strategies, factors use long-short moving average crossovers to determine direction (e.g., MA5-MA250, MA20-MA60), with rolling percentile thresholds for valuation factors. [source: "上下阈值分别设置为滚动3年的75%分位、25%分位"] Credit and inflation factors use consecutive up/down periods to determine direction. [source: "连续2期上行则认为信用因子上行，连续2期下行则认为信用因子下行"] For industry rotation, technical and macro factor weights are derived from regression: stock returns are regressed on prior-month indicators over 12 (technical) or 36 (macro) months. [source: "用当月每个股票的收益率对其上月的技术指标值回归，得到回归系数序列，以过去12个月回归系数的均值作为最新一个月的权重"] Industry-level scores are market-cap weighted from constituent stock indicators. Two implementation approaches: single-factor multi-strategy and composite factor strategy with equal-weight scoring selecting top 5 industries.
experiment: Backtesting periods and setups vary by strategy: Quarterly growth-value rotation: 2014-2026.02, with 2024.06-2026.02 as out-of-sample. Instruments: Dividend ETF and ChiNext ETF (or STAR 50+ChiNext variant). Benchmark: CSI 800. [source: "其中，2024.06.01-2026.02.27为策略样本外"] Quarterly large-small cap rotation: 2017-2026.02, with 2024.10-2026.02 as out-of-sample. Instruments: CSI 300 ETF and CSI 1000 ETF. Benchmark: CSI 800. [source: "其中，2024.10.08-2026.02.27为策略样本外"] Monthly growth-value rotation: 2014-2026.02, with 2025.01-2026.02 as out-of-sample. Instruments: Dividend ETF and ChiNext ETF. Benchmark: CSI 800. [source: "其中，2025年1月-2026年2月为策略样本外"] Monthly large-small cap rotation: 2014-2026.02, with 2024.10-2026.02 as out-of-sample. Instruments: CSI 300 ETF and CSI 2000 ETF. Benchmark: CSI 800. Dividend-growth rotation: 2015.02-2026.02. Instruments: CSI 300 Dividend Low-Vol ETF and CSI 300 Growth ETF. Benchmark: CSI 300 Total Return. Industry rotation ETF portfolio: 2014-2026.02, with 2018-2025 as out-of-sample. Benchmark: CSI 800. [source: "ETF挑选过程中，将ETF成分股对行业的覆盖度、流动性作为挑选ETF的依据"]
